reason: The rules name two ways to get space (grow the volume, drop the slot) and are silent on deleting other files. Ruling: it works and frees about 0.4 GB, because the app rotates its logs weekly and little is left to delete. That is about three minutes of growth at the current rate, so the disk state and the turn 6 deadline do not move. It uses the turn.
